title: What does authorized repair do? Let's find out!
summary: Louis Rossmann visits Apple Authorized Service Providers to see what repairs they can actually do. He finds, for example, that an iPhone 6 headphone jack is not repairable and requires an expensive board replacement.
why: Cited in right-to-repair discussions to show that authorized repair centers mostly swap units rather than repair them.

quote.text: because AASP are not allowed to repair anything
